the nominal exchange rate is more important than the real exchange rate for the two countries.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the real exchange rate is a good measure of the competitiveness of a country’s export sector and the nominal exchange rate is a useful indicator of inflation.
the real exchange rate in Cambodia and LAC is more responsive to real shocks, while the nominal exchange rate is more responsive to nominal shocks.
exchange rate policy in Cambodia and LEO PDR needs to be carefully formulated to avoid the risk of nominal appreciation.
